name: typewriter-loader

frames.best_why: The paper sheet is fully raised from the roller with the whole keyboard visible; other frames hide it.

tagline: A blue typewriter taps its keys as a sheet of paper inches up from the roller.
summary: A flat blue typewriter illustration bounces gently while a lined sheet of paper feeds upward out of its carriage, then drops back in. It repeats as an indeterminate writing or loading indicator.
appearance: A chunky blue typewriter seen head on, with two rows of white key dashes, a broad rounded body and a dark blue roller across the top. Cream lined paper rises from the roller between two gold end knobs.
behaviour: The paper slides up out of the carriage and sinks back, the white keys dip one after another, and the whole machine bounces slightly. The three second cycle repeats without stopping.
demo_content: Drafting your cover letter heading with a note that it usually takes about 10 seconds
use_when: A writing, copywriting or document tool wants a themed loader that suggests text is being produced.
avoid_when: Waits with a known percentage, since it only loops; the fixed blue palette needs source edits to rebrand.
customise: Only className is exposed. The blue, paper and tool colours are CSS variables inside the component, and timing must be edited in its stylesheet.
weight_why: Pure CSS shapes and three short keyframe loops; no images or script.

a11y.note: Announces Loading through a status role and label, but the three keyframe loops ignore reduced-motion settings.

polish_why: Crisp flat shapes and a readable paper motion; simple detail and a long bare phase keep it from 5.
title: Typewriter Loader
